D.source: Anthropic, PBC Form S-1, filed with the US SEC 26 Oct 2026
D.title: Where each dollar Anthropic spent went
notes: Each coin is one cent of operating spending. Cents rounded so they add up to exactly 100.

Operating expenses by nature, six months to 30 Jun 2026: compute and infrastructure $8,945M; sales, marketing and partnerships $3,168M; personnel $3,152M; other operating and administrative $1,714M; total $16,979M. Revenue $16,286M.

beats.caption: 53¢ of every dollar Anthropic spent went to computing power.
In all: $1.04 spent for every $1 of revenue, Jan–Jun 2026.
The moat: customers from a year ago now spend about 9× as much.
The catch, in its own filing: they stay while its models lead.
Moat: strong, but rebuilt with every model. Margin: near break-even.
What to watch: compute's share of each dollar in the next filing.
